goal: <the handed-in goal being resolved to a common understanding>

questions.question: <the question asked>
questions.code_evidence: <fact + resolved only: the code/docs path or finding that answers it (e.g. net/backoff.py:42); a resolved fact is grounded here, not asserted>
questions.human_answer: <decision + resolved only: the human/counterpart's ACTUAL answer — a decision is never self-answered by the agent>

signoff.by: <the human/counterpart who signed off — the joint-understanding finish gate; required to consolidate>
signoff.statement: <their explicit confirmation that questioning is complete and the understanding is shared; not a token>

rail_exception.reviewer_cosign: <INDEPENDENT reviewer name/id — never the author; the only way a consolidated record skips the sign-off (e.g. async counterpart)>
rail_exception.log: <why the sign-off could not be captured live and the reviewer co-signed the recorded understanding instead>
